thread:
marie_ops: Heads-up — planning a short cross-rack link affinity test and controlled GPU evacuation next Tue 02:00-03:00 UTC. Goal: validate new link steering before rolling the kernel hotfix. Expect transient packet steering changes and ~10-15% GPU capacity impact in az-west2 for 15-30m windows.
ajay_infra: Thanks — what's the exact plan? node drains, reboots, or soft-evac? any tenants pinned to the affected racks?
marie_ops: Soft-evac + interface flap to force reroute, then bring links back. We'll cordon a cohort (approx 12 nodes) at a time, migrate workloads to standby pools, then uncordon. No forced reboots unless we hit packet loss threshold.
sophie_oncall: Can we stagger by 4-node cohorts and keep latency-sensitive jobs off them? I'll update oncall playbook and alerts. Who owns the migration script run?
ajay_infra: I'll run the migration controller. Plan: 4 cohorts, 10m maintenance window per cohort, 5m observation. Use `./tools/evac --cohort $ID --drain-mode soft --kv-seed false` (runbook snippet).
nico_sre: KV cache cold starts are the risk — recommend warming via synthetic probes post-evac (small prefix requests) and avoid full cache flush. Also set autoscale goals to +20% for 30m to absorb spikes.
marie_ops: Good call. We'll seed KV with `curl -X POST https://internal/kv-seed -d '{"cohort":$ID,"keys":1000}'` after uncordon. Add that to the checklist.
elaine_support: Should we proactively message customers with high-SLA Dedicated pools in az-west2? Marketing would like a 24h heads-up for enterprise tenants. Any expected billing impact?
ajay_infra: We'll keep capacity within SLAs using standby burst capacity, but there may be some performance variance. No billing changes planned; support can offer credits case-by-case if we see regressions.
sophie_oncall: I'll add ephemeral alert thresholds: increase p50 latency alert by 30% during window and suppress noisy flaps at the service level. Also will set a pager owner per cohort.
marie_ops: Owner rotation: Ajay leads cohorts 1-2, Nico covers cohorts 3-4 for monitoring. Sophie owns paging and comms. I'll create the maintenance ticket and incident timeline.
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: CM-5489 by marie_ops for 2026-03-31 02:00 UTC — link-affinity test. See https://infra/tickets/CM-5489
nico_sre: One more ask — enable routing fallback to model-variant cheap-tier for 15m if egress drop > 2% to avoid failed requests. That will increase token costs slightly; estimate extra $60/hr in worst case.
marie_ops: Noted. Cost tradeoff: $60/hr vs potential customer errors. Approve fallback? @elaine_support?
elaine_support: Approve. We'll prep comms and a post-mortem template. Support triage play: tag customers with `impact:possible` and prioritize Dedicated SLAs.
ajay_infra: I'll attach the cohort node list to the ticket and the exact `kubectl` cordon/uncordon commands. Quick snippet to cordon: ```kubectl cordon node-{{id}}``` uncordon: ```kubectl uncordon node-{{id}}``` Keep `maxUnavailable=1`.
sophie_oncall: All right — I'll be on-call for the window. Please add me to the 02:00 bridge. :thumbsup:
marie_ops: Thanks team. I'll post the 24h comms tomorrow and kick the sequence. If anyone wants to delay, speak now or during the preflight at 01:00 UTC.
nico_sre: I'll prep the KV warmers and synthetic latency dashboard. Will post links in the ticket.
marie_ops: Closing here for now — will update ticket CM-5489 with final cohort timing and commit list.
